status: test-only correction; native acceptance and publication pending
diagnosis: The prior breakaway driver incorrectly treated any seen chasing enemy as a flank. It stood at the south approach while the freight lookout was still EAST of the low screen, exposing the entire aisle. It crossed the powered door at 49 health, reached the open return at 15 health, and died before the clinic. No script/shader error occurred.
correction: Only a visible chasing enemy west of the screen with the player triggers the breakaway. Preparation chooses two medkits and one reserved freight smoke from the same original rations and clinic drawer; no first smoke is automatically wasted at the market ramp. Medkits are used at 45 health or below rather than losing most of their healing to the 100-health cap. These are real finite controller actions. Production geometry, enemies, damage, rewards, supplies, save schema, mappings and mission goals remain unchanged.
acceptance_retained: Normal start; all five original enemies stay alive; no shooting/takedowns; both components earned; actual west-aperture crossing; genuine clinic return/save, extraction, and browser reload. No state grants or disabled threats.

model.scope: Model-action diagnostics, not browser/human/device approval. The unsuccessful sample remains reproducible.

historical_note: Earlier recovery and breakaway preflight programs remain historical experiments, not evidence of acceptance of this revised driver. The unpowered original north-route browser acceptance already passed 13 checks in 35141501302, artifact 10466256053.
human_and_physical_gates: Unfamiliar-player comprehension, replay mastery, physical Xbox/Quest, full new-route headset completion, performance, comfort, art/audio and contact IK remain unapproved.
